wineMechanicSpecification.normalAttacks: Zero effective damage without active special wine buff; ordinary stat increases cannot bypass protection.
wineMechanicSpecification.wineEmpoweredAttacks: Only the individual attacker with the active wine buff may meaningfully damage the boss. Do not turn off protection globally when one player drinks.
wineMechanicSpecification.expiration: Reverts that player to ineffective ordinary attacks. Use buff_expire visual.
wineMechanicSpecification.drops: Disciples deliver wine; eligible collection/sharing/drop quantities are intentionally undecided.
wineMechanicSpecification.allSchools: player_buff and empowered_hit are independent overlays; no hero sprites regenerated.

directionalPresentationNotes.boss: Four independently generated facings for all eleven clips.
directionalPresentationNotes.disciple: Four independently generated facings for all seven clips.
directionalPresentationNotes.vfx: Yin/palm/trails have authored right orientation; Yang authored left. Geometric VFX may be oriented later; never rotate character bodies.
directionalPresentationNotes.dashAfterimages: Generic ghost afterimage sheet is right-facing only. Other facings can use the package's actual dash_<direction> body frames as opacity overlays later; no renderer implemented.
directionalPresentationNotes.timing: Frame rates are visual playback suggestions only; never drive authoritative attack events.

alphaExport: Binary alpha at 128 threshold; transparent RGB cleared to zero. Original generator sources retained unchanged.
